sections.Aims and Fit of Module: The aim is to provide students an opportunity to carry out an in-depth and independent research project based on the research plan proposed in ENV402 under the supervision of qualified academic staff.
sections.Learning outcomes: A Demonstrate in-depth understanding and critical awareness of relevant literature B Conduct the project independently following ethics, health, and safety protocols C Demonstrate time- and project-management skills D Compose a scientific report, manuscript, or thesis in appropriate academic style and structure E Demonstrate the ability to do a public presentation about a research project, in an appropriate academic style and structure
sections.Method of teaching and learning: Weekly seminars will be provided to the students to present their progress and to discuss issues during project conduction and management with academic staff. Additional technical, lab and/or field trainings will be provided by their supervisors, technicians, or experienced PhD students if necessary.
